name: Dakota Falls power line ends
_comment: The last course of each 345 kV circuit (import-power.json leaves those courses out). The end node carries connectTo {voltage high, radius 60} (bridge 0.9.13) and attaches to the building's high-voltage marker node; its x/z only picks the marker: the substation centre moved 8 m toward the line; for the dam, the plant marker as measured on A-v6, placed in the frame of the dam edge. The start node joins the existing pylon node through snapToSegment (radius 2).

nodes.note: A-v6: extra pylon before the plant marker, spans under 210 m
